description: H52 synthetic twins (#52): defining ID headings count as identified requirement units for I1.2 and I2.2. Constructed before the H52 candidate; not independent labels. Findings are unchanged by the policy, so `expected` holds the findings both engines report. Amendment H52-1 adds the r-family-risk, range-heading, removed-heading, empty-headings and content-under-subheading twins.
